instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/outer.step and /home/user/Desktop/post.step in BRL-CAD. Cut a centered internal cavity of 100 x 60 x 30 mm from the outer block, open at the top face. Place four 10 x 10 x 30 mm posts at the inner cavity corners, with each post outer face 6 mm from the nearest outer wall; each post touches the bottom face and is fused to the outer block. Cut a 40 x 20 mm through window in the center of the front face. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). For this task, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `post.step`.
